sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Is This a Reference? is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, merc. Do you ever find yourself thinking that certain places in Tarkov look suspiciously similar to something you've already seen before? One of my outside contacts has proven to be an avid admirer of such coincidences. Well, now I need someone to set up surveillance on these listed locations. Oh, one more thing. The client asked me to tell whoever takes the job to do this with "maximum effort" and something about "207 bones in the human body", whatever that means. Looks like this comedian is bored out of his mind and doesn't know what to do with himself."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +30,000 EXP
- 200,000 Roubles
  - 210,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 230,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Streamer item case
"Well would you look at this. The customer is very pleased with the material. He even said that he himself would fit in well with the local culture with his blades and pistols. We really don't need any more katana lovers in leather suits around here... I hope his interest in Tarkov passes as quickly as it arose."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Notes |
| WI-FI Camera | 27 | Required | Can be bartered from Mechanic LL1; Can be purchased from Mechanic LL1 after accepting the quest Informed Means Armed |
| Factory emergency exit key | 1 | Required | Unlocks the locked room on the third floor of the Factory office area. |

In this quest you have to place 27 WI-FI cameras in different spots on Streets of Tarkov, Ground Zero, Lighthouse, Reserve, Customs, Factory, Woods and Shoreline.

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
The burned girl's sickroom

On the second floor of the children's polyclinic.

The really scary hole in the wall

In the Chekannaya st. 13 building, in the bathroom to the right after entering.

The barbed wire body

In the Chekannaya st. 13 building, near the marked room.

The amphibian pizza lovers' hideout

Inside the "Sewer River" extraction. Note: Most of the stashing spot is located in the extraction zone. There is a small area that allows placement without extracting when staying close to the left wall.

sections.heading: Ground Zero
sections.text:
The high rise where one die-hard guy kicked ass

Behind the reception desk of the Nakatani building.

The computer with a joke for programmers

At the Kyshperski office located on the first floor inside the southern part of the Fusion building, in the glass room with the forest wallpaper.

The little chair surrounded by big black chairs

In the conference room on the third floor (labeled 5) of the Tarbank building.

The megagenius scientist's seat

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text:
The bear who sat into a flaming car

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
The upside-down chair

In a room inside house no. 1 located in the eastern part of the west village. The door to the room has to be breached.

The not-so-lonely bathroom

The bathroom in the office building at the pier.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The "outside contact" that is hinted at in the dialogue and success message, is the character "Deadpool" from the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
- The "amphibian pizza lovers' hideout" is a reference to the "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" franchise.
- The "burned girl's sickroom" is a reference to Alessa Gillespie, one of the main characters in the "Silent Hill" game series.
- The "barbed wire body" is a reference to the game "Death Stranding".
- The "really scary hole in the wall" is a reference to the game "Silent Hill 4: The Room".
- The "high rise where one die-hard guy kicked ass" is a reference to the movie "Die Hard".
- The "computer with a joke for programmers" is not a reference to anything in particular, but shows a folder with the name "gun porn", an opened text document with binary code that decodes to "there is no escape from Tarkov" as well as an ongoing "Minesweeper" game.
- The "little chair surrounded by big black chairs" is a reference to the meme "Piper Perri Surrounded".
- "Your friend Wilson" is a reference to the movie "Cast Away".
- The "kindled rest place" is a reference to "Dark Souls" game series.
- The "ominous welcome sign" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
- The "megagenius scientist's seat" is a reference to the "Rick and Morty" sitcom series.
- The "place where conscripts did a very important task" is a reference to soldiers cleaning their barracks for visits of higher-ups, even "painting the grass green" to make a good impression.
- The "two chair riddle" is a reference to a Russian prison riddle/initiation ritual "There are two chairs. One has sharp knives sticking out. The other has erect penises. Which one do you sit on and which one do you have your mother sit on?"
- "Every tank driver's first videogame" is a reference to the game "Battle City".
- The "bucket-head villain" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
- The "Anvil 3-4 crew member's execution site" is a reference to the game "Battlefield 3".
- "Every indie developer's worst nightmare" is a reference to the game engine "Unity", which the game is made with. The developers have mentioned multiple times that the engine was not the best choice for the game.
- The "room where the firefighter burned the books to become happy" is a reference to the novel "Fahrenheit 451".
- The "place where some valve technicians couldn't finish their third project" is a reference to the unannounced game "Half-Life 3" from the developer Valve.
- The "dangerous Russian chocolate beauty" is a reference to the chocolate brand "Alenka" and the "The Terminator" movie series.
- The "conspiracy theorist's room" is a reference to the meme "Pepe Silvia".
- "Where someone thought he'd get transported to the magic school" is a reference to the "Harry Potter" movie series.
- The "mother of all strategy games" is a reference to the game "Minesweeper".
- The "stairway to the skies" is a reference to the song "Stairway To Heaven" from Led Zeppelin.
- The "bear who sat into a flaming car" is a reference to the Russian joke "Bear walks by the forest, sees a burning car. He sits inside and burns to ashes."
- According to the developers, the room with the "upside-down chair" was originally planned to get a spooky atmosphere, but the idea was never finished.
- The "not-so-lonely bathroom" is a reference to the meme "Versus Pooping".
